auditor_claire: Hi team — SOC 2 fieldwork lead here. We need an evidence handoff for 2026-03-08..2026-03-14 covering: RBAC change history, KMS rotation proof, vulnerability triage for CVE-2026-0101, and incident response artifacts (bridge logs, sign-in, postmortem). Can we get a single bundle + mapping to control IDs and a short walkthrough?
sarah-sec: @auditor_claire yep. We'll prepare a bundle with raw logs where possible and redacted CSVs for user IDs. Will include control_map.csv linking artifacts to CC6/CC7 and ISO A.9.2 equivalents. ETA EOD today.
auditor_claire: raw logs preferred; redacted user IDs are fine if needed. We'll sign a limited-scope NDA if raw principal identifiers are sensitive.
mike-oncall: I'll run the export. Command: `./tools/export_evidence --from 2026-03-08 --to 2026-03-14 --items rbac,kms,vuln,incident --out /tmp/audit_bundle.tar.gz` Then upload to s3://redwood-audit-uploads/claire/ and generate 72h presigned URL.
rob-eng: RBAC artifacts: CloudTrail events + authz-service audit stream + PR/issue context. Example entry (anonymized): `maya role.bind proj/serve 2026-03-11T10:12:33Z req-9a8b` We'll also include a CSV with justification text and link to infra PR #389.
sarah-sec: KMS details: CMK redwood-prod-01 rotated 2026-03-12T02:03:12Z. We'll attach KMS Audit events, key policy diff (pre/post), KMS envelope unwrap logs showing decrypt callers, and attestation notes that key material never left HSM.
rob-eng: Vuln triage timeline for CVE-2026-0101: scanner alert 2026-03-09T04:22Z -> triage same day -> Fix PR #412 merged 2026-03-10 -> canary 2026-03-11 -> full deploy 2026-03-11T18:00Z. Including CI artifacts, canary metrics, and change window approval.
mike-oncall: Incident evidence: bridge call recording link, sign-in logs for responders, timelines, and draft postmortem PR #413. I'll redact role session tokens.
auditor_claire: Great. Please include a README in the bundle with file checksums, list of files, redaction notes, and a CSV mapping each file to SOC2/ISO control IDs. Also indicate any gaps (e.g., masked usernames).
sarah-sec: Will do. Suggested walkthrough time 2026-03-25 09:00 UTC for 30 minutes. @auditor_claire does that work?
auditor_claire: 09:00 UTC works. Post the presigned URL and README here when upload completes. Thanks!
